mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID FROM TB_TRMA_CHAT_MEMBER WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND STATE_CD = 'A'

SELECT a.ROOM_ID ,a.TITLE ,a.TITLE_EN ,a.TITLE_JA ,m.CONTENT AS LAST_MESSAGE ,COALESCE(u.UNREAD_COUNT, 0) AS UNREAD_COUNT ,b.STATE_CD AS MY_STATE FROM TB_TRMA_CHAT_ROOM a INNER JOIN TB_TRMA_CHAT_MEMBER b ON a.ROOM_ID = b.ROOM_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m1.ROOM_ID ,m1.CONTENT FROM TB_TRMA_CHAT_MESSAGE m1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT cm1.ROOM_ID, MAX(cm1.MESSAGE_ID) AS MESSAGE_ID FROM TB_TRMA_CHAT_MESSAGE cm1 INNER JOIN TB_TRMA_CHAT_MEMBER mem1 ON cm1.ROOM_ID = mem1.ROOM_ID AND mem1.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY cm1.ROOM_ID ) m2 ON m1.ROOM_ID = m2.ROOM_ID AND m1.MESSAGE_ID = m2.MESSAGE_ID ) m ON a.ROOM_ID = m.ROOM_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cm.ROOM_ID ,COUNT(1) AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM TB_TRMA_CHAT_MESSAGE cm INNER JOIN TB_TRMA_CHAT_MEMBER mem2 ON cm.ROOM_ID = mem2.ROOM_ID AND mem2.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE cm.SENDER_ID != #{userId} AND cm.CREATE_DT > COALESCE(mem2.LAST_READ_DT, '1970-01-01') GROUP BY cm.ROOM_ID ) u ON a.ROOM_ID = u.ROOM_ID WHERE b.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY a.UPDATE_DT DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TRMA_CHAT_MESSAGE msg INNER JOIN TB_TRMA_CHAT_MEMBER mem ON msg.ROOM_ID = mem.ROOM_ID AND mem.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE msg.SENDER_ID != #{userId} AND msg.CREATE_DT > COALESCE(mem.LAST_READ_DT, '1970-01-01')

SELECT a.MESSAGE_ID ,a.ROOM_ID ,a.SENDER_ID ,b.USER_NM AS SENDER_NAME ,a.CONTENT ,a.CONTENT_EN ,a.CONTENT_JA ,a.CREATE_DT AS CREATED_AT ,( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TRMA_CHAT_MEMBER m WHERE m.ROOM_ID = a.ROOM_ID AND m.USER_ID != a.SENDER_ID AND m.STATE_CD = 'A' AND (m.LAST_READ_DT IS NULL OR m.LAST_READ_DT < a.CREATE_DT) ) AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM TB_TRMA_CHAT_MESSAGE a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_USER_INFO b ON a.SENDER_ID = b.USER_ID WHERE a.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY a.MESSAGE_ID ASC

SELECT a.MESSAGE_ID ,a.ROOM_ID ,a.SENDER_ID ,b.USER_NM AS SENDER_NAME ,a.CONTENT ,a.CONTENT_EN ,a.CONTENT_JA ,a.CREATE_DT AS CREATED_AT ,( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TRMA_CHAT_MEMBER m WHERE m.ROOM_ID = a.ROOM_ID AND m.USER_ID != a.SENDER_ID AND m.STATE_CD = 'A' AND (m.LAST_READ_DT IS NULL OR m.LAST_READ_DT < a.CREATE_DT) ) AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM TB_TRMA_CHAT_MESSAGE a LEFT JOIN TB_TRMA_USER_INFO b ON a.SENDER_ID = b.USER_ID WHERE a.MESSAGE_ID = #{messageId}

SELECT a.MESSAGE_ID ,( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TRMA_CHAT_MEMBER m WHERE m.ROOM_ID = a.ROOM_ID AND m.USER_ID != a.SENDER_ID AND m.STATE_CD = 'A' AND (m.LAST_READ_DT IS NULL OR m.LAST_READ_DT < a.CREATE_DT) ) AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM TB_TRMA_CHAT_MESSAGE a WHERE a.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND a.SENDER_ID != #{userId}
